No trackCount property on Album - requires COUNT aggregation in SPARQL over containsTrack property
Requires navigation through TrackSongRelation reification - no direct shortcut property

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are addressable but several require complex SPARQL queries or reification navigation. CQ9 has a conceptual modeling issue where Critic is modeled as separate from Person, requiring an additional critic property to link to Person. Temporal queries (CQ2, CQ3) work but require filtering rather than direct temporal snapshots.

strengths: Comprehensive annotations on all classes and properties
Proper use of reification patterns for temporal and n-ary relationships
Consistent use of inverse properties throughout
Good use of owl:FunctionalProperty where appropriate
Existential restriction on Album class enforcing CQ15 constraint
Appropriate disjointness axioms between major classes
weaknesses: Flat class hierarchy - no subclass relationships utilized
No GCAs for complex class definitions
No owl:equivalentClass axioms for necessary and sufficient conditions
Missing property domain/range restrictions as owl:Restriction axioms
No property chains defined for transitive location relationships
Limited use of advanced OWL 2 constructs (qualified cardinality, property chains)

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Creating unconnected ontology elements - Critic class structure creates awkward pattern
P8: Missing annotations - All have annotations, so this is avoided
P11: Missing domain or range in properties - All properties have domain and range
P13: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared - All inverses are declared, avoided
P22: Using different naming conventions - Consistent camelCase used throughout
reasoner_risks: Low risk overall - ontology uses standard OWL 2 DL constructs
Existential restriction on Album may cause classification time if large datasets
No obvious inconsistencies or unsatisfiable classes predicted

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Refactor Critic class. Make Critic a subclass of Person or use a Review reification pattern with hasReviewer linking to Person. Current design where Critic is disjoint with Person but needs a critic property to link to Person is conceptually flawed.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Properly answer CQ9 and improve semantic clarity. Allow persons to have multiple roles including being a critic.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add convenience properties for common queries: directlyPlaysInBand (from Person to Band), trackOfSong (from Track to Song), performedInConcert (from Song to Performance). These can be declared as sub-properties or defined via property chains.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improve queryability for CQ7 and CQ11 without requiring complex SPARQL navigation through reification.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add class hierarchy: Create MusicEntity as superclass of Song, Album, Track. Create GeographicEntity as superclass of City, Region, Country. Consider Artist as superclass of Person and Band.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Increase hierarchy depth, enable more generic queries, improve ontology organization.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add property chain axiom for transitive location: cityLocatedInCountry subPropertyOf inRegion o inCountry. This allows direct queries from City to Country.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Simplify geographic queries, demonstrate OWL 2 capabilities.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:equivalentClass axioms using restrictions. Example: CurrentBandMember equivalentClass Person and (isMemberOfMembership some (BandMembership and (not (membershipEnd some xsd:dateTime)))). This defines active members.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enable reasoning about derived concepts, improve CQ2/CQ3 handling.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add cardinality restrictions: Album should have minCardinality 1 on containsTrack (already has someValuesFrom, but explicit cardinality is clearer). Track should have exactly 1 isTrackOf relationship.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Stronger constraints, better data validation, clearer semantics.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:TransitiveProperty for geographic containment if implicit transitivity is desired (hasRegion o hasCity implies containment). Mark composedOn, releaseDate, performanceDate as having ordered values if temporal reasoning is needed.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enable transitive reasoning over geographic hierarchies, minor semantic improvements.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:AllDisjointClasses axiom grouping all major entity classes (Person, Band, Album, Song, Track, Performance, Instrument, Role, City, Region, Country) for stronger validation.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Catch modeling errors earlier, ensure cleaner instance data.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add ontology metadata: dc:creator, dc:description, owl:versionInfo, dc:created. Consider adding rdfs:seeAlso links to relevant resources.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better ontology documentation and provenance tracking.

summary: This is a well-structured ontology with proper reification patterns, complete annotations, and OWL 2 compliance. It achieves 80% CQ coverage with most gaps being queryability conveniences rather than missing concepts. The major issue is the Critic class design which creates a conceptual conflict (Critic disjoint with Person yet requiring a link to Person). Quality score of 0.72 reflects solid fundamentals but limited use of advanced OWL constructs like class hierarchies, property chains, and equivalence axioms. With targeted improvements, especially fixing the Critic pattern and adding convenience properties, this could reach 0.85+ quality.
